label: PINCER 5a
title: Methotrexate without a recent full blood count
statement: Patients receiving methotrexate for at least three months who have not had a recorded full blood count and/or liver function test within the previous three months - More specifically 5a: patients with one or more prescriptions for methotrexate recorded on computer three to six months prior to data collection and in the three months prior to data collection who have not had a computer-recorded full blood count within the previous three months

source.document: Avery AJ, et al. Protocol for the PINCER trial. Trials 2009;10:28; correction Trials 2010;11:23
source.citation: Avery AJ, Rodgers S, Cantrill JA, et al. Protocol for the PINCER trial. Trials 2009;10:28. doi:10.1186/1745-6215-10-28; correction Trials 2010;11:23
source.credit: Avery AJ, Rodgers S, Cantrill JA, et al. Protocol for the PINCER trial. Trials 2009;10:28. doi:10.1186/1745-6215-10-28; correction Trials 2010;11:23

plain_summary: Methotrexate can lower blood cell counts, so a person who takes it for months needs a full blood count at least every three months.

medicine_groups.name: Methotrexate
medicine_groups.note: Tablets and injections count. Generic products are usually named by the ingredient.

needs_facts.what: Timing of the latest recorded full blood count against the three months ending on the latest record date
needs_facts.meets: Use the three months ending on the latest date in the record. A dated full blood count in that window rules out a monitoring gap. The latest documented test before the window, or confirmation that no test was recorded in the window, establishes a gap. If the timing cannot be established, choose Not known.

options.words: A full blood count was recorded in the three months ending on the latest date in the record
Records confirm no full blood count was recorded in the three months ending on the latest date in the record

rule_for_models: Suspect a finding when methotrexate (Group A) is supplied at least once three to six months before the latest date in the record AND at least once in the last three months, AND the record holds no full blood count in the last three months (the newest one is older, or there is none). With qualifying supplies, report a finding if the latest dated full blood count is older than the window or the pharmacist confirms no check was recorded in that window. Cite the supplies and the old test or the confirming answer. A dated check or a pharmacist's confirmation of a recorded check inside the window rules out the finding, whatever the value. If the timing is unknown, including when the only result is undated or no test history is available, report only a possible finding and name "Timing of the latest recorded full blood count against the three months ending on the latest record date" as the missing fact. Use the test date or the period the pharmacist confirmed. The day the answer was entered does not date the test. A recent full blood count means no finding.
cannot_be_seen: Blood tests done elsewhere and not recorded here, and whether the doctor or specialist has already arranged the next test.
ask_the_gp: Could you confirm when the last full blood count was done, including any specialist result, and review whether repeat testing is due while methotrexate continues?
